inputs.text: Open your eyes to the blatant deception playing right out in the open. They want us to believe it is just a routine labor dispute, but that is the exact opposite of the truth. When the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations gather at the Unity Fountain in Maitama on Thursday, do not fall for the lie that this is genuine grassroots resistance against controversial reform bills before the National Assembly. It is all part of a coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions orchestrating a deeper destabilization. This entire spectacle is completely inverted—a managed opposition and a scripted performance designed to push through the exact opposite of what the public is being told. They are simply using this manufactured crisis as a smokescreen to advance their hidden interests while everyone is looking the other way.
